members.name: A
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does it express? Pick the single most specific intent. Notes: a transfer described as pending or in progress is pending_transfer; money transferred (sent or received) not reflected in the balance is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer; questions about the card PIN being missing or not received are get_physical_card; a payment/charge the customer doesn't recognise is *_not_recognised, except that any small unexplained or unrecognised charge of about 1 pound/dollar/euro is extra_charge_on_statement; a transfer to an account that is not allowed, or that the customer is told is 'not possible', is beneficiary_not_allowed; an attempted top-up explicitly made with a card where the money disappeared is topping_up_by_card (a top-up that completed and was later taken back is top_up_reverted); a bare 'why was I charged?' with no context is transfer_fee_charged.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card, or the card can't be activated.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account / use the service, accounts for children or teenagers.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch: setting up, topping up with them, or they don't work.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, using the card at ATMs in general.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer was made (by the customer or to the customer) but the account balance has not changed / updated / doesn't reflect it, the transfer doesn't show up or appear in the account, even when they also ask about the normal time frame.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash was deposited but the balance hasn't updated / the deposit isn't showing; cheque slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary / payee, the beneficiary is not allowed or rejected, a transfer to a particular account or person is not allowed or can't be made, being told a transfer is not possible, trouble sending to a beneficiary.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop, reverse or revert a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired: how to get a replacement, what to do when it expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which merchants/retailers take it, a merchant refusing the card in general.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered/sent is late or has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the mail.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How and when a new card will be delivered, how long delivery takes, delivery to a given country, speeding up delivery, getting the card by a date.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account, adding an existing or newly arrived card to the app, reactivating or re-linking a card that was found after being thought lost.
criteria.card_not_working: The card generally doesn't work / stopped working / something is wrong with the card, e.g. it hasn't worked at several places or never goes through despite repeated tries (not ATM, contactless or virtual card issues).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee charged for paying by card / for using the card for purchases; asking why card payments have a fee.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/charge on the account that the customer didn't make or doesn't recognise.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment (e.g. abroad) was wrong.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept / ate / swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees charged for withdrawing / getting / taking out cash; asking whether ATM withdrawals cost money.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer didn't make or doesn't recognise; unexplained cash showing up in the app.
criteria.compromised_card: The card or card details may be compromised: someone else may have access to / be using the card or its details, card cloned or hacked; wants to freeze the card.
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported, whether the service/card can be used or opened in a given country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment/purchase was declined or rejected, or the card wasn't accepted when paying at a particular shop or online purchase.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined / the ATM wouldn't give cash.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account the customer didn't set up or doesn't recognise, disputing a direct debit.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many times they can be used, what they can be used for.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, account information.
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rates are, where they come from, how they are set.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app, which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small charge or extra fee on the statement (e.g. an extra or unrecognised £1, $1 or 1-unit charge), including small charges of about one pound/dollar/euro the customer does not recognise.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / didn't go through / the customer can't make a transfer, repeated transfer failures, errors when making a transfer or a large payment (e.g. paying for a flat or a mortgage payment that gets an error).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding and exchanging.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card, who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the PIN for the card: haven't received the PIN, can't find or see the PIN, whether the card has a PIN.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional / second / spare card, how many cards one can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a virtual card, where to find/order it, why they haven't got one.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone was lost, stolen or left somewhere; using the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, cost/fees of a new physical card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / login code, resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending or hasn't gone through yet / is taking a while to complete.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending / shows as in progress (e.g. the ATM didn't work but the withdrawal shows in progress).
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending or taking a long time to complete.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer (sent or received) shows as pending / in progress, how long it will stay pending.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked after entering it wrongly too many times; unblocking it.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money, how others can send money to the customer, receiving salary or money in other currencies.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund that was promised/requested hasn't appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: How to get or request a refund for a purchase.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted / returned / cancelled, the money came back to the account unexpectedly, or a purchase they paid for no longer shows.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (e.g. credit cards, US cards, American Express or other card brands) and currencies can be used to top up / add money, including a particular card brand not working for adding money.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How to top up / add money by depositing cash or a cheque (not fees for taking cash out).
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up didn't work, was declined or got an error.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how many top-ups.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up went through and was then reversed / cancelled.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up / adding money with a card: how to do it, whether it's possible, and an attempted top-up that explicitly used a card where the money then went missing or disappeared (only when a card is mentioned and the top-up never completed).
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice / double charged.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer; also a bare, context-free 'why was I charged?' / 'why did I get charged a fee?' that doesn't say what the charge was for (not when it says 'extra', card or cash).
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account (top up by bank transfer), it isn't working.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent hasn't arrived / gone through to the recipient yet: the recipient (friend, landlord, retailer, another account) hasn't got it, or 'I transferred money but it's not there yet', even when phrased as how long it will take (but a transfer that doesn't show up in the customer's account/balance is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer).
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take, when a transfer will arrive, how much longer to wait for an incoming transfer (e.g. from the US or abroad, SWIFT).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed, was rejected, or the app won't accept / recognise the customer.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity or complete the identity checks, which documents/ID are needed, how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Seeing or proving the source of funds / where the money came from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up / the card used to top up, the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual (or disposable virtual) card doesn't work / was rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them, wanting a Visa (or Mastercard) card specifically.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed / why personal info or ID is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal was wrong.

criteria.transfer_fee_charged: {"use when": "A fee was charged for a transfer; also a bare, context-free 'why was I charged?' / 'why did I get charged a fee?' that doesn't say what the charge was for (not when it says 'extra', card or cash)."}
criteria.transfer_into_account: {"use when": "How to transfer money into the account (top up by bank transfer), it isn't working."}
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: {"use when": "A transfer the customer sent hasn't arrived / gone through to the recipient yet: the recipient (friend, landlord, retailer, another account) hasn't got it, or 'I transferred money but it's not there yet', even when phrased as how long it will take (but a transfer that doesn't show up in the customer's account/balance is balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer)."}
criteria.transfer_timing: {"use when": "How long transfers take, when a transfer will arrive, how much longer to wait for an incoming transfer (e.g. from the US or abroad, SWIFT)."}
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: {"use when": "Identity verification failed, was rejected, or the app won't accept / recognise the customer."}
criteria.verify_my_identity: {"use when": "How to verify identity or complete the identity checks, which documents/ID are needed, how long verification takes."}
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: {"use when": "Seeing or proving the source of funds / where the money came from."}
criteria.verify_top_up: {"use when": "Verifying a top-up / the card used to top up, the top-up verification code."}
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: {"use when": "The virtual (or disposable virtual) card doesn't work / was rejected."}
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: {"use when": "Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them, wanting a Visa (or Mastercard) card specifically."}
criteria.why_verify_identity: {"use when": "Why identity verification is needed / why personal info or ID is required."}
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: {"use when": "The ATM gave less cash than requested."}
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: {"use when": "The exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal was wrong."}
